type: Short live production browser interaction through the shared Chrome UI
observations: Before publication the stable production URL displayed version 0.12 and eleven campaign missions.
After the verified production deployment, reload displayed version 0.15.2 and fourteen campaign missions, including MI12, MI13 and MI14.
The simulations view listed three independent operations.
Simulation 02 Le dernier bac was selected through its visible card, then its briefing and Deploy button.
The M-12 Vigie entered the visible battlefield; the painted convoy and rifle combatants rendered with transparent backgrounds.
The Right arrow was sent twice through the browser UI. The convoy changed from waiting to moving and its objective advanced from 3% to 4%.
Escape opened the pause dialog. Resume returned to the battlefield. A second Escape reopened the pause dialog.
The final live tab is left paused with Resume available and marked as a deliverable.
inputDurationScope: Durations describe the requests to the UI tool; actual event hold duration and native frame pacing were not measured.
